# Attack Plan — Thirty Failure Questions

1. Can nested routes vanish from commerce?
2. Can root-level apps vanish from commerce?
3. Can two catalog identities share one physical route?
4. Can a renamed product strand credits?
5. Can a marketplace badge infer the wrong product from URL shape?
6. Can static marketing claim commerce when server catalog disagrees?
7. Can a credit pack exist without a consume action?
8. Can a duplicate purchase charge twice?
9. Can concurrent credit consumes overdraw?
10. Can a failed job consume credits without delivering value?
11. Can checkout erase user work?
12. Can offline UI imply payment success?
13. Can promotional and purchased Peruta be confused?
14. Can bought credits silently expire?
15. Can reward faucets inflate liabilities?
16. Can a 360px screen hide purchase actions?
17. Can safe-area insets cover launchers?
18. Can focus escape a dialog?
19. Can reduced-motion users avoid costly animation?
20. Can shared commerce CSS break editors or games?
21. Can catalog cards overflow or become noisy?
22. Can crawler-visible pages remain empty despite rich runtime catalogs?
23. Can product routes 404 while marketplace cards remain active?
24. Can unknown SKU metadata enter client display?
25. Can analytics leak private project content?
26. Can a disabled SKU remain advertised?
27. Can product readiness regress without CI failure?
28. Can server and browser normalize identity differently?
29. Can future developers understand every mapping without archaeology?
30. Can the next agent resume directly from REMAINING_WORK?
